league.title: This week’s league
league.endsIn: Ends in {time} · {n, plural, one {the top player moves up} other {top # move up}}
league.rule: Points = this week’s learning XP + good habits. Habits: 10 points for every trade with its reason noted in the journal and 10 for every buy with a stop (up to 3 of each per week), and 20 if your portfolio is spread out (3 or more positions and no single stock above 40 %). What your portfolio gains or loses doesn’t score. Everything resets on Monday.

league.how2: You earn points with XP from lessons and quizzes, and with good habits in your virtual portfolio: noting your reason, setting a stop and diversifying.
league.how3: On Monday, the top {up} move up a division and the bottom ones move down. Then everything resets.

push.title: Turn on notifications
push.body: We’ll remind you before you lose your streak, when you leave a lesson halfway and when something moves in the market. Never at night, and you choose which ones in Settings.
push.denied: Notifications are blocked in this browser. You can allow them in its settings.
push.error: They couldn’t be turned on. Try again.
push.ios1: Tap Safari’s Share button (the square with the arrow).
push.ios3: Open E-Trading from that icon and turn on notifications.
push.iosHint: On iPhone, add E-Trading to your Home Screen (Share, «Add to Home Screen») and open it from the icon to turn on notifications.
